content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITION_OF_CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: Confidential Information means any proprietary information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party agrees to maintain the confidentiality of the Confidential Information and not to disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERM
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect until the expiration of the term as set forth in Section 4 hereof.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 20th day of February 2024.
